benefits_features_and_faqs.about_overview: Axis Bank Horizon Credit Card is an airline-agnostic travel credit card. At an annual fee of Rs. 3,000, the card offers travel benefits in the form of EDGE Miles redeemable at a 1:1 ratio across multiple travel partners. Besides air miles, the card also offers domestic and international lounge visits , along with bonus miles as welcome and renewal benefits, positioning the card as a strong competitor to cards like Axis Atlas and SBI Miles Elite.
highlights: 5 EDGE Miles per Rs. 100 spent on Axis Bank Travel EDGE portal and direct airline websites/counters
2 EDGE Miles per Rs. 100 spent 1 on all other spending categories
Flights and hotel bookings through Axis Bank’s Travel EDGE platform

Convert your EDGE Miles into partner miles at a value of 1 EDGE Mile = 1 Partner Point through Axis Bank’s Miles Transfer program, except for British Airways, Finnair, and Lotusmiles, where 2 EDGE Miles = 1 Partner Point

faqs.q: What are the ongoing offers on the Axis Bank Horizon Credit Card?
faqs.a: The card offers exciting offers every Wednesday on popular brands. You can avail 15% savings on travel bookings (flights and hotels) on Goibibo and MakeMyTrip. Additionally, avail 10% off on Swiggy, Amazon Fresh, and Tira.

faqs.q: What are the cash withdrawal charges on this card?
faqs.a: The card charges a cash withdrawal fee of 2.5% of the transaction amount (minimum Rs. 500). In general, withdrawing cash using a credit card is not advisable. Along with the withdrawal charges, the interest is charged on cash advances right from the day of making the transaction; the interest-free period does not apply for credit card cash withdrawals.

faqs.q: What is the forex markup charge on this card?
faqs.a: Despite being a travel credit card, the card does not offer any concessional forex markup fee. On international transactions, a standard forex markup fee of 3.5% of the transaction amount is applicable.

faqs.q: What is the eligibility criteria to avail this card?
faqs.a: You can avail the Axis Bank Horizon credit card if you are aged between 18 and 70 years. Except for this, the bank decides your eligibility based on factors like your monthly income, credit score, credit history, etc.

faqs.q: How much do I save via the welcome benefits offered on the card?
faqs.a: Considering a redemption value of 1:1, with 5000 bonus reward points, you can get a value back of 5000 air miles, redeemable against travel partner points.

faqs.question: What is the annual fee for the Axis Horizon Credit Card?
faqs.answer: The joining and annual fee is ₹3000 + GST, or ₹3540 including GST. There is no spend-based annual fee waiver.

faqs.question: Is the Axis Horizon Credit Card lifetime free?
faqs.answer: Eligible Burgundy customers with savings accounts opened on or after 1 July 2026 can get Horizon lifetime free, subject to maintaining the required relationship. Those already holding a lifetime-free Select, Magnus or Horizon cannot get another under this offer. Welcome and renewal miles are not available on lifetime-free cards.

faqs.question: How do I get the Axis Horizon welcome bonus?
faqs.answer: On paid cards, your first transaction must be ₹1000 or more and made within 30 days of card issuance to qualify for 5000 EDGE Miles. A smaller first purchase makes you ineligible, even if you spend more later. For cards issued from 1 September 2026, the bonus can take up to 60 days from the qualifying transaction.

faqs.question: Does Axis Horizon require minimum spending for lounge access?
faqs.answer: The current Horizon lounge terms do not specify a minimum spending requirement. Access is available to the primary cardholder at participating lounges, within the quarterly limits.

faqs.question: How many airport lounge visits does Axis Horizon offer?
faqs.answer: Visa cardholders get 8 domestic visits per calendar quarter, while Mastercard cardholders get 6. Both variants offer 2 international visits per calendar quarter. These benefits apply to the primary cardholder.
